en.html:
I was told I was not qualified.

That I would only make everybody unhappy.

And I nodded. Haan. Absolutely. I knew how foolish I was, how powerless. No difficulty believing the worst about myself. On this subject, I was one very cooperative fellow.

So I gave in.
Made my decision.

...But.

Not qualified?
Then should I not have struggled to become qualified? Or was the whole benefit of being useless that nobody could ask me to become useful?

I would make people unhappy?
Then should I not have worked to bring them happiness as well?

No. I took the part that let me give up, called it a decision, and carried it very seriously. Look at this responsible man. He has accepted that he cannot take responsibility.

Why could I not make the OTHER decision?

Why did I abandon the responsibility of my own blood?

————The sin is here.

————There is the enemy.

Yes.
Here only.

ja.html:
資格が無いと告げられた。

　誰もを不幸にするだけだと。

　その言葉に、頷いた。

　自分の愚かさ、そして無力を知っていた。

　だから屈した。

　決断をした。

　…………しかし。

　やはりあれは、間違った決断ではなかったか。

　資格が無いなら、
　資格を得ようと奮うべきではなかったか。

　不幸にしてしまうなら、
　幸福も生むよう、努めるべきではなかったか。

　何故その決断ができなかったのか。

　血の責務を放棄してしまったのか。

　――――――罪はここにある。

　――――――敵はそこにいる。

　そう。
　ここにいる。

One alone.

Therefore.

This man alone must be judged.

With all my heart, I hate him.

————Therefore.

The absolute rule takes effect.

The soul thinks only of love.

Commanding them both,

one curse takes flight.
